## Featured Case Studies
- [IncepBio Website](https://www.incepbio.com): Built a 20-page B2B website from scratch and grew organic search from zero to 2.5K+ clicks (up 71%) and 33.5K impressions (up 146%) in 3 months, with Google page 1 rankings for core service pages. Configured Odoo CRM lead capture with UTM tracking.
- [Balaji Travels Case Study](https://manikandan-portfolio-alpha.vercel.app/#work): Published 1,300+ SEO blogs, built 3,300+ backlinks, resolved 99K+ internal links, improved Core Web Vitals, and ranked competitive travel keywords in Google's Top 20.
